images.title: Only the last digit decides
images.purpose: Shows that the last digit of 34² comes only from the last digit 4: 4² = 16 ends in 6, so 34² = 1156 ends in 6.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three short expressions in one horizontal chain across the middle, joined by two arrows.
images.exact_structure: Left: the expression 34² in large dark digits, with the digit 4 ringed in teal (#0072B2). A dark arrow points right to the middle expression 4² = 16, with its final 6 ringed in reddish purple (#CC79A7). A second dark arrow points right to 34² = 1156, with its final 6 ringed in reddish purple. Under the chain, centred, the short caption last digit decides. Exactly 3 rings and 2 arrows. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame

images.takeaway: The last digit of a square depends only on the last digit of the number.
images.description: Shows that the last digit of 34² comes only from the last digit 4: 4² = 16 ends in 6, so 34² = 1156 ends in 6.
